inputSource: Real pi-agent-core Agent/message shapes; scripted StreamFn (no network); in-memory ProbeStore; production kernel source imported unmodified.

findings.question: 真实 PI 消息进入流程时，哪些步骤执行、哪些跳过
findings.evidence: shouldStopAfterTurn ran; gate.evaluate saw {"inputRoles":["user","assistant","toolResult"],"hasToolResultMessage":true,"hasLegacyToolResultBlock":false,"resultHasEnvelope":false,"resultEvidence":false}; consolidate received roles=["user","assistant","toolResult"]; real tool result message role=toolResult
findings.detail: The gate is reached but finds no target: it searches user messages for a legacy tool_result block, while PI appends a separate toolResult message.

findings.question: 自动回忆是否调用存储检索并产生 l2_recall
findings.evidence: searchMemory calls=0, searchMemoryMulti calls=0, anchors after turn 1=["consolidation_state","rolling_summary","consolidation_state","rolling_summary"], consolidate hasRetrievalEvidence=[false,false,false]
findings.detail: The L2 lookup scans assistant content for type 'tool_use' with .input.query; PI writes type 'toolCall' with .arguments, so the query is never found.

findings.question: 模型返回 reuse 时程序是否正确识别
findings.evidence: real event shape {type:'text_delta',delta:'reuse'} -> compress; legacy event shape {type:'text',text:'reuse'} -> reuse
findings.detail: adjudicateReuseCompress only accumulates event.type === 'text' && event.text; runner then read its verdict from the empty text and defaults to compress.

findings.question: 额外补搜取得的资料是否进入下一次模型请求
findings.evidence: turn 2 request roles=["user"]; reround URL absent (and no reround happened: retriever calls=1)
findings.detail: The gate never produced an enriched envelope, and even if it had, shouldStopAfterTurn can only return a boolean; its applyTo() array is not written back to agent state. pi-agent-core 0.84.2 offers prepareNextTurn(context) for that, which production does not use.

findings.question: 压缩有没有减少实际输入；旧工具结果是否仍完整发送
findings.evidence: same-run request#1(messages=1, est tokens=10) -> request#2(messages=3, est tokens=2768); old tool result text chars=3072; [Session Memory] in same-run request#2=true, in next ans_chat-style run=true
findings.detail: No old message is dropped: request#2 still carries the full tool result plus the summary block when it arrives. The summary lands on the NEXT call (fresh Agent); within the same run the background summarization loses the race with the next provider request.

findings.question: 总结和判断额外增加了多少调用与 token
findings.evidence: summary calls=3; [{"chars":3586,"estTokens":897,"includesOldToolResult":true},{"chars":4069,"estTokens":1018,"includesOldToolResult":true},{"chars":1922,"estTokens":481,"includesOldToolResult":false}]; adjudication calls=0 (post-search trigger never true)
findings.detail: Each compression adds one standalone summarization request that re-serializes the whole conversation. Adjudication is unreachable because hasRetrievalEvidence stays false.

findings.question: 摘要锚点是否按预期保存
findings.detail: rolling_summary and consolidation_state are written; the summary content itself is injected later, but only as an addition.

findings.question: 最小适配：把 toolResult 折成旧 role:'tool' 后，缺口提炼是否恢复
findings.evidence: real gap text chars=0, results=0; adapted gap text chars=2402, results=2
findings.detail: One shape adapter restores distillGap; without it the summarizer prompt's gap section stays empty.

findings.question: 最小适配：把 toolResult 折成旧 user/tool_result 合并块后，补搜是否恢复
findings.evidence: hasRetrievalEvidence=true; reround retriever calls=1; gate streamFn call shape=[{"firstArgKeys":["model","messages","thinkingLevel"],"secondArgKeys":["apiKey"],"firstArgLooksLikeModel":false}]
findings.detail: Shape adapter restores discovery and reround. The gate's own streamFn call still uses the old 2-argument form, separate from the message-shape mismatch.

findings.question: 补搜结果是否能进入下一次主模型请求（即使 gate 已恢复）
findings.evidence: applyTo produced enriched adapted messages containing probe.example=true; the real next request still has no reround URL. Production hook cannot return a message array.
findings.detail: Even with the shape fixed, shouldStopAfterTurn returns only a boolean. Wiring reround evidence into the next request needs prepareNextTurn(context) (available in 0.84.2), which is a wiring change, not a shape fix.

findings.question: 最小适配：回合结束上下文里如何取到“这一轮搜索过”
findings.evidence: current code reads lastToolName/toolName -> ""; real context keys=["message","toolResults","context","newMessages"]; toolResults-based extraction -> true
findings.detail: ShouldStopAfterTurnContext exposes message/toolResults/context/newMessages. The tool name is on toolResults, not on the context root.

findings.question: 最小适配：把 toolCall/arguments 折成 tool_use/input 后，L2 回忆是否恢复
findings.detail: The same content re-expressed in the legacy names restores query extraction, store recall, and the l2_recall anchor.

findings.question: 最小适配下，L2 回忆还受 messages.length > 4 约束
findings.evidence: messages=5, hasRetrievalEvidence=true, totalTokens=0 -> anchors=["consolidation_state","l2_recall"]; one search turn alone is 3 messages
findings.detail: Even with names and evidence flag fixed, a single search turn never triggers post-search consolidation; L2 recall needs at least five messages (two tool rounds) or the token watermark.

findings.question: 最小适配：把 text_delta 映射为旧 text 事件后，reuse 识别是否恢复
findings.detail: An event-name shim restores the adjudicator's verdict parsing.

findings.question: 缓存能否观察到（客户端复用 / 服务商输入缓存 / 历史资料复用）
findings.evidence: scripted provider reports cacheRead=["no usage fields","no usage fields","no usage fields"]; no provider cache exists in this loop
findings.detail: The scripted provider cannot show provider-side cache. Client-side reuse is absent too: each ans_chat call builds a fresh Agent with no carried history, so only anchors (summary/digest) cross calls.
